name: bank_routing
instructions: A customer sent this message to a digital bank's support chat. Which specific request type best describes it?

criteria.card_payment_not_recognised: A card payment, purchase or charge on the account that the customer did not make or does not recognise, an unknown charge (even if they ask for the money back)
criteria.cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: A cash/ATM withdrawal the customer did not make or does not recognise
criteria.direct_debit_not_recognised: A direct debit or debit transaction the customer did not set up, does not recognise, or wants to cancel, dispute or get refunded
criteria.compromised_or_stolen_card: Card currently lost, stolen, or compromised; suspicious activity; someone else using the card or account; freezing the card or account for security (not a card that has since been found)
criteria.lost_or_stolen_phone: Customer lost their phone, it was stolen, or they do not have their phone with them (e.g. left it somewhere) and ask about using the app or account
criteria.passcode_or_login: Forgotten app passcode, passcode not accepted, cannot log in to the app
criteria.pin_issue: PIN problems: PIN blocked, PIN not working, finding the PIN, changing the PIN
criteria.card_swallowed: An ATM swallowed / kept / took the customer's card
criteria.charged_twice: The same payment or transaction appears twice / duplicate charge
criteria.wrong_cash_amount: ATM gave less cash, a different amount, or not the amount of cash the customer wanted or requested
criteria.request_refund: Customer wants a refund from a merchant, wants to cancel an order or purchase, changed their mind, goods not received, wants to dispute a card purchase with a merchant
criteria.refund_not_showing: A refund the customer expected has not appeared on the account
criteria.reverted_card_payment: A card payment that was cancelled, came back, was reverted or returned to the account; what happens when a card payment is cancelled
criteria.card_arrival: Ordered or new card has not arrived yet; tracking the card delivery
criteria.card_delivery: How long card delivery takes, delivery dates, delivery to other countries
criteria.card_linking: Adding / linking a card to the app, including a card the customer found after thinking it was lost and wants to reactivate or use again
criteria.order_or_replace_card: Ordering a physical card, a new or replacement card, a card about to expire
criteria.spare_card: Getting an additional / second / spare card
criteria.virtual_card: Getting or using a virtual card or disposable virtual card, their limits, virtual card not working
criteria.visa_or_mastercard: Whether the card is Visa or Mastercard; choosing between them
criteria.card_acceptance: Which merchants, shops or ATMs accept the card
criteria.card_not_working: Card not working, contactless not working, card payments being declined
criteria.declined_cash_withdrawal: ATM refused / declined a cash withdrawal
criteria.pending_card_payment: A card payment still showing as pending, or a payment taking a long time to go through
criteria.pending_cash_withdrawal: An ATM cash withdrawal the customer made that is still pending, or the balance not matching after their own ATM withdrawal
criteria.apple_google_pay: Using Apple Pay, Google Pay or a smartwatch/phone wallet (e.g. Apple Watch), including adding funds or topping up through them
criteria.supported_cards: Which card brands (Visa, Mastercard, American Express) the bank accepts, e.g. for topping up
criteria.top_up_how: How to top up the account: by card, bank transfer, cash or cheque; where to top up
criteria.top_up_limits: Limits on top-ups and on the card or account (e.g. daily limit, maximum amount)
criteria.top_up_problem: A top-up that failed, is pending, was reverted, or whose money has not appeared
criteria.transfer_into_account: Adding money to the account via transfer from another account, receiving money
criteria.transfer_timing: How long a transfer takes; transfer pending or not yet arrived
criteria.transfer_not_received: Recipient has not received a transfer the customer sent
criteria.transfer_failed_or_declined: A bank transfer that failed or was declined
criteria.cancel_transfer: Customer wants to cancel, undo or revert a transfer or transaction they sent (not a merchant order); transfer or payment made to the wrong account
criteria.balance_not_updated: Balance not updated after a bank transfer, cheque or cash deposit
criteria.transfer_methods: Types of transfers available (SWIFT, international), using a credit card to transfer
criteria.card_payment_fee: Fee charged on payments or purchases made with the card (card payment fee), including asking why some payments have fees or complaining about such a fee
criteria.atm_fee: Fee or charge for cash withdrawals / ATM use, including complaints about such a fee
criteria.transfer_fee: Fee charged for sending or receiving a transfer, including complaints about such a fee and whether the full amount sent will arrive or be reduced
criteria.top_up_fee: Fee for topping up by card or bank transfer
criteria.extra_charge: An extra fee or small extra charge (e.g. an extra 1 pound, or a 1 pound charge the customer thinks is in error even if they bought nothing for that amount) showing on the statement or in the app, when it is not identified as a card payment fee, ATM fee, transfer fee or top-up fee
criteria.exchange_rate_info: General questions about exchange rates: what the rates are, how they are determined, what rate the customer will get
criteria.wrong_exchange_rate_applied: Complaint that the wrong or an unexpected exchange rate was applied to a purchase, card payment or cash withdrawal the customer made
criteria.currency_exchange: How to exchange currencies in the app; which currencies are supported
criteria.verify_identity: Identity verification: documents needed, why it's needed, verification not working
criteria.verify_top_up: Verification of a top-up (verification code for a card top-up, why top-up needs verification)
criteria.beneficiary_not_allowed: Beneficiary not allowed / cannot add a payee / transfer blocked to a beneficiary
criteria.country_support: Countries where the service, account or card is available or can be used; using it all over the world; eligibility to get a card when living outside the UK
